mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Channels: by name, keyword search or who is live in a category. Live streams: in categories or site-wide. Clips: of channels or categories. Videos: of channels. Top categories: the 100 most watched.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channel names or URLs, e.g. shroud, twitch.tv/pokimane. Used by Channels, Clips and Videos.

categories.title: Categories (games)
categories.description: Category names exactly as on Twitch, e.g. Fortnite, Just Chatting, Chess, League of Legends. Used by Channels (who is live there), Live streams and Clips.

searchQueries.title: Channel search
searchQueries.description: Keywords for Twitch's channel search, e.g. valorant, cooking, asmr. Channels mode only; up to 100 channels each.

languages.title: Stream languages
languages.description: Two-letter codes, e.g. en, es, de, fr, pt, ja. Filters live streams and live channels; each language is read separately, so more languages return more streams.

minFollowers.title: Minimum followers
minFollowers.description: Optional. Drops channels and streams with fewer followers.

videoType.title: Video type
videoType.description: Which videos to list for each channel.

maxItems.title: Max rows per source
maxItems.description: Stop each channel list, category or search after this many rows. Twitch returns up to 100 clips, videos or categories and about 30-90 live streams per category and language.
